description:
2+years of hands-on, direct experience with modern front-end structural 
frameworks/libraries (Angular.JS, Backbone, React, Ember).

Demonstrated knowledge of and success leveraging modern mobile and 
web MVC frameworks (Angular.JS, React.JS, Backbone.js, jQuery, Sencha, 
Kendo)

Core UI/UX design skills, with an ability to map out complex 
information architectures (at a variety of resolutions) and link these 
to user needs.

A deep understanding of user-centered design and an ability to 
integrate design into the creation of new product and service offerings 
across digital, service and system domains.

Ability to engage with technical (mobile and networked) domains, 
including familiarity with MVC concepts, HTML5, CSS, Javascript, and a 
track record of working with the people who implement these solutions. 



 Skill:  Core UI/UX design, Angular.JS, React.JS, Backbone.js, jQuery, Sencha, Kendo


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
